markers.label: Houston added
markers.text: Houston becomes a delivery port at the same 1.25c discount as the other non-NY ports.

markers.label: Cup: no aged taste
markers.text: Graders reject coffee that tastes aged, which limits how long a lot can stay deliverable in practice.

markers.label: Brazil deliverable (−9¢)
markers.text: Brazil semi-washed becomes deliverable at a 9c discount (approved by the ICE board Dec 9, 2010).

markers.label: Steeper age discount
markers.text: Discounts on coffee more than two years old become much steeper.

markers.label: Virginia added
markers.text: Virginia becomes a delivery port at par with New York.

markers.label: Colombia +4¢, Brazil −6¢
markers.text: Colombia premium doubles to 4c; Brazil discount narrows to 6c (announced March 2014).

markers.label: Load-out adjustment
markers.text: Warehouses with dear load-out charges pay the receiver the difference to New York.

markers.label: Gulf/Miami −0.50¢; rent adj.
markers.text: US Gulf and Miami discount narrows from 1.25c to 0.50c; European ports stay at 1.25c.

markers.label: Re-grading barred
markers.text: Ends the de-cert / re-cert route: the age discount now sticks to the lot for life.

markers.label: EU: bonded only
markers.text: Only bonded (non-cleared) coffee can sit in European certified stocks.

markers.label: EUDR transition rules
markers.text: EU-port certs without EUDR paperwork lose value from the March 2027 contract; legacy stocks (B/L before Jun 29 2023) exempt.

markers.label: US ports: duty paid
markers.text: US-port certs must be duty paid, so any US tariff on an origin is borne by the coffee before grading.

markers.label: KC ends Mar 2028
markers.text: March 2028 is the last KC delivery; from May 2028 the benchmark is the metric contract.

markers.label: EUDR DDI required
markers.text: From 30 Dec 2026, new EU-port gradings need EUDR due-diligence data; older transition stock stays deliverable at a growing discount.

markers.label: Col/CR/Kenya +10¢
markers.text: Colombia, Costa Rica and Kenya deliver at 10c over the futures and Guatemala at 5c over, from the March 2026 contract (in force now). The rulebook prints the May 2027 schedule after this one; May 2027 only adds Vietnam.

gap.ico_note: ICO group indicators: daily ex-dock prompt-shipment prices for named current-crop export grades in the USA and Europe (Germany, France), built as futures plus trade differentials, US cents/lb; the group price weights the two markets by export share. ICO's 'New York' is the average of the ICE 2nd and 3rd positions.

origin_now.rule: Schedule C-2 'Effective with the March 2026 contract' (amended by the Board Dec 20 2023, eff. Feb 12 2024; ICE notice Jan 16 2024): Colombia, Costa Rica, Kenya +1000; Guatemala +500

origin_next.rule: Schedule C-2 'Effective with the May 2027 contract' (amended Mar 27 2025, eff. Apr 15 2025; Submission 25-51): Vietnam added at -600, premiums unchanged from March 2026

port_now.rule: Schedule C-3 amended Mar 23 2017, May 2019 delivery and later (current)

age_bands.rule: Appendix V items (1)-(12), March 2013 and later (current)

changes.old: NY basis; New Orleans, Miami, Antwerp, Hamburg/Bremen -125 pts
changes.plain_english: Houston becomes a delivery port at the same 1.25c discount as the other non-NY ports.
changes.source_note: NYBOT Coffee C rules (Schedule C-3 for March 2005 and later)

changes.old: Honduras, Venezuela, Peru -100; Burundi, India, Rwanda -300; Colombia +200; DR, Ecuador -400
changes.new: Mexico, Central America, Kenya, PNG, Tanzania, Uganda, Panama, Peru, Honduras at basis; Venezuela, India -100; Burundi, Rwanda -300; Colombia +200; DR, Ecuador -400
changes.plain_english: Origin schedule in force for most of the 2005-2016 period (Brazil not deliverable).
changes.source_note: NYBOT Coffee C rules (Schedule C-2 for July 2005 and later)

changes.new: coffee showing any hint of aging in the cup fails grading
changes.plain_english: Graders reject coffee that tastes aged, which limits how long a lot can stay deliverable in practice.
changes.source_note: SCA News, citing rulebook amendment of Apr 15, 2009 (eff. Apr 24, 2009)

changes.new: Brazil semi-washed arabica deliverable at -900 pts (9c under)
changes.plain_english: Brazil semi-washed becomes deliverable at a 9c discount (approved by the ICE board Dec 9, 2010).
changes.source_note: ICE press release Dec 9 2010; Appendix IV footnote (amended Dec 9 2010; eff. March 2013)

changes.old: 721-1080 days: 825 pts + 75 per 30 days; over 1080: 1725 + 100 per 30 days
changes.new: 721-1080: 825 + 100 per 30 days; then 125, 150 ... 300 pts per 30 days in steps of 360 days (2025 pts at 1080 days, 3525 at 1440, 18825 at 3600)
changes.plain_english: Discounts on coffee more than two years old become much steeper.
changes.source_note: Appendix V items (4)-(15), amended Dec 9 2010, effective with March 2013; earlier schedule from the NYBOT rulebook

changes.new: Port of Virginia added at basis (same as New York)
changes.plain_english: Virginia becomes a delivery port at par with New York.
changes.source_note: Schedule C-3 footnote: amended Jul 9 2014, eff. Jul 29 2014

changes.plain_english: Colombia premium doubles to 4c; Brazil discount narrows to 6c (announced March 2014).
changes.source_note: Comunicaffe Apr 11 2016; Schedule C-2 footnote amended Feb 27 2014, eff. May 2016

changes.new: invoice adjusted by NY average load-out rate minus the delivering warehouse's load-out rate
changes.plain_english: Warehouses with dear load-out charges pay the receiver the difference to New York.
changes.source_note: Appendix V footnote: amended Mar 23 2017, eff. Apr 12 2017, July 2017 and later

changes.new: New Orleans, Miami, Houston -50 pts; Antwerp, Hamburg/Bremen, Barcelona -125 pts; NY and Virginia basis
changes.plain_english: US Gulf and Miami discount narrows from 1.25c to 0.50c; European ports stay at 1.25c.
changes.source_note: Schedule C-3 footnote: amended Mar 23 2017, eff. Apr 12 2017, May 2019 delivery and later (old value from the NYBOT rulebook)

changes.new: invoice adjusted by (NY average storage rate minus delivering warehouse storage rate) x 2 (Mar, May, Jul) or x 3 (Sep, Dec)
changes.plain_english: Cheap-rent warehouses add to the invoice, dear ones deduct.
changes.source_note: Appendix V footnote: amended Mar 23 2017, eff. Apr 12 2017, May 2019 and later

changes.rule_area: Re-grading of de-certified coffee (Rule 8.10(a); Appendix II(b))
changes.old: de-certified coffee could be resubmitted and got a new certificate with a new date, wiping out the age discount
changes.new: coffee previously submitted for grading may not be resubmitted (appeals only)
changes.plain_english: Ends the de-cert / re-cert route: the age discount now sticks to the lot for life.

changes.new: coffee in Antwerp, Barcelona, Hamburg/Bremen must be non-customs-cleared to be graded; certs that clear customs lose their certificate
changes.plain_english: Only bonded (non-cleared) coffee can sit in European certified stocks.

changes.new: coffee in EU ports with bill of lading on/after Jun 29 2023, submitted for grading before Dec 30 2026 and without validated EUDR due-diligence data: discount 25 pts per month from Jan 2027 (2027 months); 300 pts + 50 per month from Jan 2028
changes.plain_english: EU-port certs without EUDR paperwork lose value from the March 2027 contract; legacy stocks (B/L before Jun 29 2023) exempt.
changes.source_note: Appendix VIII adopted May 15 2024 (eff. Jun 3 2024); discount paragraphs amended Nov 14 2024 (eff. Dec 3 2024); later amendments Sep 10 2025 and Dec 5 2025

changes.new: also: coffee in New York, Virginia, New Orleans, Houston, Miami must be customs cleared and free of import duties, taxes and tariffs
changes.plain_english: US-port certs must be duty paid, so any US tariff on an origin is borne by the coffee before grading.
changes.source_note: Appendix VII amended Apr 8 2025, effective Apr 8 2025

changes.old: KC listed up to 60 months out
changes.new: no KC futures listed beyond March 2028; Coffee C Metric (AC) from May 2028
changes.plain_english: March 2028 is the last KC delivery; from May 2028 the benchmark is the metric contract.
changes.source_note: ICE Submission 25-157 (Aug 21 2025), citing Submission 25-130; rulebook Chapter 8 notice

changes.rule_area: EUDR: validated due-diligence data (Appendix VIII para 1)
changes.new: non-legacy coffee submitted for grading in EU ports on/after Dec 30 2026 must have Validated DDI; certificate revoked if it becomes invalid
changes.plain_english: From 30 Dec 2026, new EU-port gradings need EUDR due-diligence data; older transition stock stays deliverable at a growing discount.
changes.source_note: Appendix VIII para 1 amended Sep 10 2025 (eff. Nov 26 2025); further amendment Dec 5 2025 (eff. Dec 26 2025)

changes.rule_area: Origin differentials: premiums for top washed origins
changes.old: Colombia +400; Costa Rica, Kenya, Guatemala basis
changes.plain_english: Colombia, Costa Rica and Kenya deliver at 10c over the futures and Guatemala at 5c over, from the March 2026 contract (in force now). The rulebook prints the May 2027 schedule after this one; May 2027 only adds Vietnam.
changes.source_note: ICE notice Jan 16 2024; rulebook Schedule C-2 note 'Amended by the Board December 20, 2023; effective February 12, 2024 [with the March 2026 contract]'; ICE product specification page lists the premiums as current

changes.new: Vietnam washed arabica deliverable at -600 pts
changes.plain_english: Vietnam washed arabica becomes deliverable at a 6c discount (same as Brazil), from the May 2027 contract.
changes.source_note: ICE Submission 25-51 (Apr 1 2025), effective Apr 15 2025, from the May 2027 contract

changes.new: AC: 10 t, US$/t; bags or FIBCs up to 1 t; Barcelona dropped; differentials are the KC ones converted to $/t; spot-month limit 850 lots (8,500 t)
changes.plain_english: From May 2028 coffee is delivered on the metric contract (AC). Values are the same as KC to within rounding; the changes are lot size, big bags and Barcelona.

Brazil export-quality prices (B3 arabica 4/5 good cup, co-op semi-washed, tipo 6)

eudr_transition.note: Appendix VIII: Transition Stocks discount from the May 2028 contract, $121/t plus $11/t per calendar month thereafter; not for Legacy Stocks or coffee graded on/after Dec 30 2026

ac.packaging: natural-fibre bags (as KC) or new woven polypropylene FIBCs up to 1 t (ISO 21898 class 3.1.3); a lot is all bags or all FIBCs; FIBC = 15 bags for load-out
ac.certificates_note: Neither Chapter 14 nor Submission 25-157 says whether coffee holding a Chapter 8 (KC) Certificate of Grade is deliverable on AC; a re-submission ban applies as in KC (Rule 14.10(a)).
